## About

- Data analyst background: cleaning, questioning, and translating data into decisions.
- Now building AI-first: web apps, automations, practical AI integrations.
- Personal: husband, father, archer.
- Contact: michaeljwilt@outlook.com (replies within 24h)

## Services (side work)

1. Websites & landing pages — fast, modern, sharp on every screen.
2. Dashboards & data apps — live KPIs people actually look at.
3. Automations & AI tools — hand the repetitive stuff to a machine.
